summary: Frustrated by quota display inconsistency, questioning Navi's analysis
detailed_context: Ivan asked Navi to fix something that 'wasn't right' (исправь что не таак было). Navi provided technical analysis of HealthMonitor issues and made changes (reducing Z.AI max_tokens). However, Ivan's follow-up reveals he's confused or frustrated about quota reporting: Z.AI quota shows 3/1000 (1%) in one place but doesn't display correctly in the 'PAI STRATEGIC' tab/window. Ivan is questioning why the quota data isn't being shown accurately across the UI if it's being used in multiple places (both here and in A0). This suggests: (1) Navi's fix may not have addressed Ivan's actual concern, or (2) Navi missed a quota display bug while focusing on HealthMonitor, or (3) Navi's explanation didn't clarify why quota data is inconsistent. The tone is questioning/skeptical ('почему... если'), indicating Ivan doesn't understand why the problem exists or doubts Navi's previous work was complete. This is mild frustration born from incomplete problem resolution or miscommunication about scope.
